title: Planned maintenance: nbn services connected via Petrie, Caboolture and Aspley (QLD)
current_summary: Planned maintenance is scheduled between 11:00pm on Monday 2 November and 7:00am on Tuesday 3 November 2026 (Queensland time). During this window, nbn services connected through the Petrie, Caboolture and Aspley areas may be interrupted for up to 8 hours.

cause.reason: Planned splice infrastructure replacement by a network provider.

updates.content: A network provider will be replacing splice infrastructure that supports nbn services connected through the Petrie, Caboolture and Aspley areas in Queensland. The work is scheduled between 11:00pm on Monday 2 November and 7:00am on Tuesday 3 November 2026 (Queensland time). Some nbn services in these areas may be interrupted for up to 8 hours during this window. We will share more information if anything changes.
